_about: Who lives where in the Castle of the Apocalypse II, and which doors their keys open (src/population.py, applied when the world loads, so a rebuild of world/zones keeps it). The owner, 2026-10-12: Kirgan the Destroyer holds the key to the guardian's chamber; Pestilence is in the room right after the door from the Inner Hall; War at the end of the guardian chambers; Famine in the other guardian chambers on the far side (14163); Death the final boss.

bosses.why: Kirgan the Destroyer, in the Guard Room off the inner corridor: he carries the inner gate key (his loot, every time)
Pestilence, in the first Guardian Chamber, through the Inner Hall's locked door
War, at The End Of The Guardian Chambers (the east wing)
Famine, in the guardian chambers on the far (west) side
Death, the final boss, at The Gates To Hell

doors.name: inner gate
doors.why: the Inner Hall's door into the Guardian Chambers opens to Kirgan's key
